prompt.zh-TW: 綠丘單車行目前的負債比率是 {{percent:vars.ratio}}，離課程參考值還有一點空間。老闆阿哲想開第二家店，資金有三種來源。三個做法都說得通，你會建議哪一個？重點是你怎麼看參考值與風險。
prompt.en: Green Hill Cycles currently has a debt ratio of {{percent:vars.ratio}}, a little below the course reference value. The owner, Che, wants to open a second shop and has three ways to fund it. All three can make sense; which would you suggest? What matters is how you weigh the reference value against the risk.

text.zh-TW: 向銀行借一筆長期貸款來開第二家店
text.en: Take out a long-term bank loan to open the second shop

upside.zh-TW: 不必稀釋阿哲的股權，利息也是固定的；只要新店賺的錢高於利息，股東的報酬會被放大。
upside.en: Che keeps his full stake and the interest is fixed; as long as the new shop earns more than the interest, the shareholders’ return is magnified.

downside.zh-TW: 負債比率會明顯上升、接近課程參考值，利息不管生意好壞都要付；一旦新店不如預期，壓力會集中在阿哲身上。
downside.en: The debt ratio rises noticeably towards the course reference value and the interest has to be paid whether trade is good or bad; if the new shop disappoints, the pressure lands squarely on Che.

text.zh-TW: 找一位新股東增資，一起開第二家店
text.en: Bring in a new shareholder and open the second shop together

upside.zh-TW: 負債比率不升反降，沒有固定的利息負擔；新股東可能也帶來經驗或人脈。
upside.en: The debt ratio falls rather than rises and there is no fixed interest burden; the new shareholder may also bring experience or contacts.

downside.zh-TW: 阿哲要分出一部分所有權和未來的利潤，重要決定也要多一個人同意。
downside.en: Che gives up part of the ownership and future profits, and important decisions now need one more person’s agreement.

text.zh-TW: 先不展店，用自己賺的錢慢慢存，存夠了再開
text.en: Do not expand yet; save up from the shop’s own profits and open when there is enough

upside.zh-TW: 資產結構最穩，不用付利息也不用分股權；也有時間確認第一家店的模式真的站得住。
upside.en: The most stable structure: no interest and no shared ownership, and time to confirm the first shop’s model really works.

downside.zh-TW: 可能錯過好的店面或市場時機；對手如果先展店，第二家店的位置可能就沒了。
downside.en: It may mean missing a good location or the right moment; if a competitor expands first, the site for the second shop may be gone.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 參考值不是判決書。借款能放大報酬也放大風險，增資最穩但要分享所有權，等待最保守但有機會成本。網站的看法是：先問新店的現金流量有多確定；確定度高、而且借款後的負債比率仍在阿哲睡得著的範圍內，借款合理；確定度低，增資或等待比較穩。不論選哪一個，開店後都要回頭看負債比率、{{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}}與現金流量比率有沒有一起變差。
viewpoint.en: A reference value is not a verdict. Borrowing magnifies both return and risk; new equity is the steadiest but means sharing ownership; waiting is the most cautious but has an opportunity cost. The site’s view: first ask how certain the new shop’s cash flow is. If it is fairly certain and the debt ratio after borrowing stays at a level Che can sleep with, a loan is reasonable; if it is uncertain, new equity or waiting is safer. Whichever he chooses, he should afterwards check whether the debt ratio, the {{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}} and the cash flow ratio are deteriorating together.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
